run-grow-transform-spend-mix: How IT spend splits between keeping things running (Run), growing the business (Grow) and changing the business (Transform).
roadmap-delivery-vs-plan: How many of the milestones we committed to were delivered on the planned date.
it-spend-as-pct-of-revenue: IT spend as a share of company revenue, month by month.
budget-vs-actual-and-forecast-variance: How actual IT spend compares with budget so far, and where the year is expected to end.
cloud-spend-and-waste: What we pay for cloud each week, and how much of it is unused or oversized.
contract-renewals-due-6-12-months: Contracts that come up for renewal in the next 6 to 12 months, with the date we must tell the vendor by.
project-health-rag: Projects reported as Green (on track), Amber (some concerns) or Red (in trouble), plus Green ones whose reports hint at delays.
deployment-frequency: How often new software is released to live systems.
technical-debt-trend: How much past shortcuts in our applications slow down future work. Lower is better.
availability-vs-sla-critical-services: How much of the time critical services were up, compared with the agreed target.
p1-p2-incidents-and-mttr: Serious incidents and the average time it takes to restore service.
critical-vulnerabilities-open-patch-sla: Serious security weaknesses that are still open, and how many were patched within the agreed deadline.
mfa-and-privileged-access-coverage: Share of accounts protected by multi-factor authentication, including admin accounts that have extra powers.
audit-findings-open-and-overdue: Issues raised by auditors that are still open, and how many are past their due date.
end-of-life-legacy-footprint: Systems whose vendor no longer provides support or security fixes.
application-portfolio-time: Every application placed in one of four groups: keep as is (Tolerate), keep and grow (Invest), move to a better platform (Migrate) or retire (Eliminate).
ai-use-cases-by-stage: AI ideas, pilots and live use cases, to show how many are moving from idea to production.
ai-adoption-and-realised-value: How many people actively use AI tools, and the yearly benefit: measured from data versus self-reported.
